info.name: Traktor Kontrol S5
info.author: Serveny
info.description: HID Mapping for Traktor Kontrol S5

option.label: Keylock on :hwbtn:`SHIFT`+:hwbtn:`SYNC`
option.description: :hwbtn:`SHIFT`+:hwbtn:`SYNC` toggles keylock instead of making the deck the tempo master. Holding :hwbtn:`SHIFT`+:hwbtn:`SYNC` still copies the key.

option.label: Main gain is handled by the Mixxx built-in mixer
option.description: When enabled, the master potentiometer on top right column of the mixer will drive both the main gain of the Mixxx internal mixer as well as the hardware built-in mixer in the device. This is useful if you aren't relying on the hardware output, but could result in undesired clipping if enabled when using the hardware audio outputs.

option.label: Booth gain is handled by the Mixxx built-in mixer
option.description: When enabled, the booth potentiometer on right column of the mixer will drive both the booth gain of the Mixxx internal mixer as well as the hardware built-in mixer in the device. This is useful if you aren't relying on the hardware output, but could result in undesired clipping if enabled when using the hardware audio outputs.

option.label: Headphone gain and cue mix is handled by the Mixxx built-in mixer
option.description: When enabled, the headphone volume and cue potentiometers on bottom right column of the mixer will drive both the headphone controls of the Mixxx internal mixer as well as the hardware built-in mixer in the device. This is useful if you aren't relying on the hardware output, but could create undesirable clipping if enabled when using the hardware audio outputs.

option.label: Loop encoder sensitivity when moving a loop
option.description: How far one :hwbtn:`LOOP` encoder step moves the loop in loop move mode (:hwbtn:`SHIFT`+:hwbtn:`FLUX` on an active loop).

option.label: Loop encoder sensitivity when moving a loop (shift)
Open the browser on touch
option.description: Touching the :hwbtn:`BROWSE` encoder opens the track list.
